notablePrerequisites: You have four or more cards in your graveyard.
description:
Cast Underworld Breach.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Memnite, milling yourself for three.
Cast Memnite by exiling three cards from your graveyard that are not Thassa's Oracle.
Repeat steps 2 and 3 until you have no cards in library.
Cast Thassa's Oracle.
Resolve its enter the battlefield trigger.
